headline: Violent Clashes Grip Stonecradle and Expanse as Fighting Stirs Stlican Shelf
war_summary: Severe engagements have intensified across Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse over the latest three hours, with both sectors remaining ferocious cauldrons logging thousands of casualties alongside recurring base turnover at World's End, The Reach, and Crow's Nest. Combat has also renewed on the Stlican Shelf, where accelerated fighting yielded immediate base transactions at Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage exhibits a dramatic escalation in attrition, consuming fifteen hundred personnel in two hours without immediate territorial exchange. In Linn of Mercy, active base disputes persist around Lathair even as casualty tempos cool slightly from their earlier highs. Conversely, the Dead Lands, Mooring County, and Nevish Line sectors have settled into prolonged quiet, registering minimal combat across their respective lines. Maritime and rearward zones remain entirely dormant, leaving the war's momentum concentrated across the central and northern interior.
